headline: Predictive models refine chromatin architecture, cohesin binding, and nucleosome dynamics
label: Deep Learning For Chromatin Regulation
summary: Recent work pairs sequence-aware deep learning and reprocessed cohesin ChIP-seq with simulation-based kinetic analysis of nucleosome allostery.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational inference of chromatin organization and regulatory state from binding, epigenetic, and sequence data. ChIANet predicts protein-mediated contact maps and loops from binding profiles, while ChIP-FRiP reprocesses 140 cohesin ChIP-seq datasets and models antibody background to correct cohesin positioning at CTCF sites. chromIDEAS groups chromatin states by epigenetic composition and genomic distribution, applied to THP1 leukemia. CONDACT quantifies time-resolved kinetic correlations from molecular dynamics of nucleosome core particles. DeepECC addresses a related but distinct problem, predicting cancer eccDNAs from breakpoint-flanking sequences. What is new is the emphasis on explicit background modeling and predictive frameworks that connect binding data to three-dimensional architecture and nucleosome-level dynamics.
